# Kingston Nyamapfene

Kingston Nyamapfene is a Zimbabwean agricultural professor and a former vice chancellor of the University of Africa.
Education
Kingston obtained his first degree in English from the University of London in 1971. In 1978, he obtained his Masters degree in Agronomy and International Agriculture from Cornell University. In 1985, he bagged his doctorate in Earth Sciences from the University of Aberdeen in Scotland.
Academic career
Kingston Nyamapfene is a former vice president of International University of Grand Bassam. He served as the assistant provost of online learning and also the Dean of the College of Continuing education in Texas.
Personal life
Kingston Nyamapfene is a citizen of Zimbabwe and the United States of America with South Africa permanent resident.
